scientific_integrity: The ordinary Leibniz derivation theorem is proved by Fourier rigidity and an orbit compatibility count; numerical checks are corroborative, and no independent mathematical audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Odd dihedral quandle order at least three with coefficient characteristic not dividing n; the result does not classify even n or modular characteristic dividing n. The finite-field checker samples prime fields and selected orders, not all cases.
title: Modular resonance and the derivation algebra of odd dihedral quandle algebras
